changes: City list confirmed: the trucksimulator.wiki.gg West Balkans page says the DLC adds 30 cities, and the dataset has exactly 30 (SI 4, HR 5, BA 7, RS 4, XK 1, ME 3, AL 4, MK 2). The Slovenia list (Koper, Ljubljana, Maribor, Novo Mesto) and the Montenegro list (Bijelo Polje, Nikšić, Podgorica) match the wiki. Tiranë, Durrës, Fier, Vlorë, Zagreb, Niš, Kragujevac, Tuzla and Pristina have their own wiki city pages. No cities added or removed.

No West Balkans map changes found in updates 1.57 (Scandinavia refresh), 1.58 (physics and route advisor), 1.59 (Benelux rework, May 2026) or 1.60 (visuals, June 2026), so the city list stands as of Nov 2026.
Candidate 'Villach' (radio_only under SI) rejected for this region: it is an Austrian city (AT region), not a Slovenian one.

Gjirokastër (AL) is NOT an in-game city. It is not one of the 30 West Balkans cities, the Greece DLC adds only Greek cities, and the wiki search found no Gjirokastër entry (it lies on the road between Tepelenë and Kakavia). The Greece dataset's Ioannina-Gjirokastër edge should be replaced by Ioannina-Fier and Ioannina-Vlorë.
Fier-Ioannina: km 200 -> 190, conf low -> medium. The SCS blog 'Greece border crossings' (Jul 2024) confirms the Kakavia Albania-Greece crossing is in the game.
Added edge Vlorë-Ioannina (205 km, medium). The mezha.media Greece DLC review names the Vlora-Ioannina road as the best route in the game.

Niš-Sofia: km 370 -> 158, road changed to A4/E80 via Pirot - Dimitrovgrad - Gradina/Kalotina, conf low -> high. The wiki border-crossing list includes Gradinje (RS) - Kalotina (BG) on A4 / I8, and the real Niš-Sofia road distance is about 155-160 km. The old 370 km route via Zaječar was not the direct link.

Beograd-Sofia: conf low -> medium, road named. The wiki border-crossing list confirms Vrshka Chuka (RS) - Vrashka Chuka (BG) on R36 / II12, and the Paraćin village page says its road runs east toward Bulgaria.

Ferries Split-Ancona (10 h, €315), Durrës-Ancona (18 h, €615) and Durrës-Bari (9 h, €420) confirmed by the trucksimulator.wiki.gg ferry table (Italia + West Balkans). No Zadar or other Croatian ferry found. City and ferry notes updated.
Karakaj-Beograd: conf low -> medium. A Steam discussion titled 'Karakaj border crossing' describes driving the Serbia-to-Bosnia route through it.
Novi Sad-Szeged: conf medium -> high. The West Balkans release notes (SteamDB) name the large-scale Horgoš crossing.

Skopje-Pernik kept at low conf: no web evidence was found for an in-game North Macedonia-Bulgaria crossing, but it is not disproved. The release notes count 10 new crossings to existing countries (HU, BG, RO, AT, IT).
All other cities and edges kept unchanged (not disproved).
